Question_text: In order to stay alive, cells depend on soluble molecules being able to enter and leave them. You are going to use pieces of agar, a firm jelly, to represent three cells, A, B and C. The agar is coloured red with an indicator. You will place each piece in an acid solution. When the acid diffuses into the agar, the red indicator will change to a yellow colour. You will measure the time it takes for each piece to completely change colour.
Unit: UNIT 3: Movement into and out of cells

Question_text: Vegetarian sources of protein, for example beans and single cell proteins, are increasingly being used throughout the world. You are provided with two bean seeds.
